$comment: R67 F-28 (audit recommendation R-249) -- the per-screen latency budget.
Every figure is the audit's own target, not an aspiration invented here:
ttfbMs        400   warm time to first byte
fcpMs         800   first contentful paint
usableMs     1500   [data-state='ready'|'empty'] on the list region (F-31)
networkIdleMs 2500  no in-flight request for 500 ms
apiCalls       10   /api/* requests the screen makes
slowestCallMs 2000  no SINGLE call may exceed this
toleranceFraction is applied to every numeric budget before a row is
failed, so a busy runner does not fail a PR on noise. It does NOT apply
to apiCalls: a screen making 22 requests instead of 10 is a design fact,
not measurement jitter, and that is the exact regression this budget was
written to catch (/scope's per-row compare fan-out, R-239/F-23).
A route is measured with a real project selected -- projectIdParam says
whether ?projectId= must be appended, since a screen with no project
resolves one over the network and is not the thing being measured.

routes.label: Reports
routes.$comment: Reports has no table of its own; usable is its picker being interactive, so its list region is the result panel.

$comment: The direct backend probe. It calls PROJEXA's own proxy routes and reads
the Server-Timing header this item adds -- upstream;dur is VERIDIAN's
own cost, app;dur is the hop's. That keeps the two separable WITHOUT
putting a VERIDIAN org API key into CI, which calling the ERP directly
would require.
